utils.parse_db_timestamp treats naive DB timestamps as UTC and returns aware datetimes; app.py freshness + automation badges use it (TypeError → 'Unknown' gone). 6 regression tests incl. real CURRENT_TIMESTAMP format.

expires_at now written in SQLite-native UTC space format; all reads/purge/stats compare via datetime(expires_at) > datetime('now') which also normalizes legacy T-format rows. Real-SQLite test documents the old 'T'>' ' bug and proves the fix.

Background-search failures persisted in geo_search_error; rendered after the post-job rerun with a Dismiss button; cleared on successful search, new search (reset), and reset button. Error no longer flash-wiped by st.rerun().

Intent contact-search and enrichment PipelineError handlers now complete the run as 'failed' (mirroring the generic handlers); a new intent search closes any prior open run as 'cancelled — superseded' before starting; geography's equivalent landed with HADES-aoe (reset-on-search completes the prior run). Radius expansion steps skipped with an explicit reason when center_zip is absent (manual ZIP list / template mode) — no more byte-identical duplicate sweeps (~20 wasted API calls/search) and no fake 'radius → 20mi' entries in the expansion report. 2 regression tests.

Selection sync now merges: rows hidden by filters keep their selection (with a visible 'N hidden — still selected' hint); the data_editor key includes filter state so a filter change gets a fresh editor instead of stale positional edits remapping onto different companies.

states_conflict veto on the fuzzy tier of find_duplicates + flag_duplicates_in_list: two KNOWN different states can never fuzzy-match (proof of distinct companies); unknown state proves nothing (no behavior change); exact phone+name tier unaffected. Measured false pairs (atria/artis, north/south dallas fitness) pinned as tests. 6 regression tests.

Reentrant per-instance lock (lazily created; safe for cached singletons) serializes execute/execute_write/execute_many/multi-row-insert and is held across the whole transaction() — one user's transaction can no longer skip another's commits or interleave partial state. Stale-stream reconnect inside an open transaction now RAISES instead of replaying one statement and committing a partial transaction. Rollback failure no longer masks the original error. 4 regression tests.
